children: Big Yellow said the sale follows on from the previously announced disposals of its industrial estates in Harrow and Staines.
Following completion of the sale, the FTSE 250-listed group highlighted that it will have received combined gross proceeds of £81m from the three disposals.
As of 1000 BST, Big Yellow shares were down 0.18% at 828.50p.
Reporting by Iain Gilbert at Sharecast.com
